theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 := by
  have h : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = (n ^ 2 % 2 + n % 2) % 2 := mod_add_right
  have h1 : n ^ 2 % 2 = n % 2 := Nat.pow_mod n 2 2
  rw [h1] at h
  have h2 : n % 2 + n % 2 = 0 ∨ n % 2 + n % 2 = 1 := by cases n % 2; rfl
  cases h2
  · rw [h] at this
    rw [add_zero] at this
    exact this
  · rw [h] at this
    rw [add_one] at this
    exact this
